Magby

Fire

Johto · Generation 2 · Baby Pokémon

Magby is a Fire-type Live Coal Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2), and is classed as a Baby Pokémon. It stands 0.7 m tall and weighs 21.4 kg. It evolves into Magmar. Its highest base stat is Speed (83), with a base stat total of 365.
